look_here_first: Texas sweet Indian mallow: small yellow 5-petal mallow flower, small hairy heart-based leaves, and a compact dry fruit with about 6–9(–10) unspined mericarps. For A. incanum lookalike count 6–9 style branches instead of 5. DO NOT require a hairless staminal tube: FNA and UT/Kew disagree.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: Compact 6–9(–10)-mericarp schizocarp with short, not long-spined segment tips

key_traits.label: Flower
key_traits.text: 5 yellow or yellow-orange petals, 5–10 mm long (FNA). Style commonly 6–9 branches. FNA reports glabrous staminal column, but detailed Texas material says some stellate hairs and Kew treatments report hair; do not rely on absence of hair.

key_traits.label: Fruit seed
key_traits.text: Schizocarp cask-shaped, 8–9 × 8–9 mm; mericarp apex acute/apiculate, tomentulose; 3 seeds per mericarp, seeds ~2 mm.

lookalikes.differences: Separate from velvetleaf (A. theophrasti) by the smaller leaves and compact fruit; separate from A. incanum by plain yellow flowers and more style branches.
